verdict.rationale: Skills are plain filesystem folders: a SKILL.md plus optional scripts/, references/ and assets/ directories. After installation every instruction and script is an ordinary file on disk that a reviewer can read, and a runtime probe confirmed an installed SKILL.md read back cleanly. However, the evidence shows no documented first-party way to list or preview a skill's or plugin's contents before installing it; the probe's selective install used third-party `npx skills` tooling. Missing for 10: a documented pre-install content listing or preview in /plugin install or the marketplace, and a first-party review or audit view of installed skill files.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can review exactly what instructions and scripts a skill will add — list contents before installing and read every file afterward

citations.quote: Defined as filesystem artifacts**: you create each skill as a `SKILL.md` file in its own directory
Skills are folders of instructions, scripts, and resources that Claude loads dynamically to improve performance on specialized tasks.
